encoding: five normalized variables: first model, second model, mode(single1/single2/pair), image share, text share; integer bins and capability-only repair; same seeded model permutation across three generic methods
initialization: same four exact charged routes and all cached observations; DE starts with their four best deployments, DA starts at their best, Random retains the same incumbent
primary_budget: 64 actual uncached complete candidate predictions including initialization; identical objective and deployment/route domain
schedule: fixed shuffled order, same process, one BLAS thread; BO-MADS rerun with fixed exit logic for same-batch timing
stop_rule: one fixed batch; no performance retries, parameter tuning, extra seeds or workload expansion
evidence: existing synthetic convex queue-cost benchmark; not actual FIFO/GPU or a server deployment trace
reference: sealed reference intervals and independent formula used only in post-run audit
